CASE_ID_UNIQUE.rule: Every case ID must match ^Q[1-6]_[a-z0-9_]+$ and be unique across the entire qualification battery.

CASE_VERSION_FROZEN.rule: Every case must carry an immutable semver string; mutable drafts are rejected.

EVIDENCE_SCOPE_VALID.rule: All synthetic evidence items must be bound strictly to the declared task scope.

EVIDENCE_KEY_RESOLVABLE.rule: Evidence references must resolve to legal (task_id, evidence_key) tuples parseable by EvidenceResolver.

SOURCE_CAPABILITY_CONSISTENT.rule: Declared source capabilities must match available platform capability definitions.

INPUT_TRUTH_SEPARATED.rule: Model visible input package must contain zero ground truth answers, dispositions, or criteria.

HOLDOUT_NOVELTY_ATTESTED.rule: External author and custodian must attest that scenarios share no overlap or contamination with F1-F4.

CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_FROZEN.rule: Candidate prompt hash (e00c1549...) and schema hash (a214ec4f...) must match exact frozen baseline.
